name: u.u

scripts.build:css: npm run build:families && npm run build:themes && npm run gen:registry
scripts.build: npm run build:css && vite build && npm run prepack
scripts.prepare: svelte-kit sync && npm run gen:registry || echo ''
scripts.check: npm run build:css && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json

description: * `Source Tailwind` -> Équivalent CSS * `@apply inline-flex shrink-0 …` -> Propriétés CSS explicites * `@apply no-underline` -> text-decoration: none * `@apply appearance-none` -> appearance: none * `@apply rounded-full px-0` -> border-radius: 9999px + padding-inline: 0 * `@apply w-full max-w-64` -> width: 100% + max-width: 16rem * `@apply bg-base-content/10` -> color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-base-content) 10%, #0000)
